scope.excluded_work: all catalog problems and research tracks other than #021/B7, #022/B2, and #023

question: Can a preregistered unsigned 16-bit even-weight decoder, selected only after the public 9-bit regression, reproduce every fresh X/Z window syndrome, window output, final frame, and residual exactly?

external_source_profile.pymatching_rule: For each decomposed causal edge, aggregate marginal and joint probabilities by Bernoulli XOR; set p_implied=min(0.5,joint/marginal), w_implied=log((1-p_implied)/p_implied), and only replace a target edge when the implied weight is lower.
external_source_profile.pymatching_discretization: When every base and implied user weight is integral, get_edge_weight_normalising_constant returns 1 and both paths store 2*round(weight), guaranteeing even internal edge weights.
external_source_profile.micro_blossom_source_interpretation: The pinned source requires even graph weights and reserves LoadWeightsExternal, but Edge.scala still marks dynamic edge-weight update TODO, its external write ports are commented, Instruction.scala has no operational load generator, and the embedded solver rejects nonempty dynamic_weights. Static graph compatibility does not establish a functional dynamic write path.

adapter_contract.purpose: Expose insertion of already-computed integer implied-weight rules into the pinned PyMatching UserGraph so the candidate can exercise the unchanged two-pass decoder without asking PyMatching to derive or rescale candidate weights from probabilities.
adapter_contract.allowed_change: two pybind insertion methods for ordinary and boundary edges; no matching, reweight, discretization, or decode algorithm is changed
adapter_contract.hardware_interpretation: software semantic audit adapter only; not Micro Blossom RTL, Verilator, FPGA, cycle, or timing evidence

prior_result_correction.summary: The public v1 producer label is rejected because its semantic_pass omitted the frozen all-window syndrome/output equality clause. V1 remains valid evidence that 9-bit weights preserve all final frames and residuals, but its 12 syndrome and 24 output mismatches in X plus 17 syndrome and 34 output mismatches in Z fail strict streaming substitutability.

post_outcome_route_selection.epistemic_status: Every row below reuses the already-public failed v1 holdout and can select a later candidate but cannot provide acceptance evidence.
post_outcome_route_selection.selection_rule: Choose the first tested power-of-two scale above 1024 that clears both bases, rather than cherry-picking an arbitrary integer scale.

candidate_contract.reference_full_block: unquantized PyMatching 2.4.0 two-pass correlated decode over the complete 1,000-round detector error model
candidate_contract.reference_online: unquantized public correction-bit fault-vector decoder under the frozen 3d window, d commit, and 2d look-ahead contract
candidate_contract.candidate_base_graph: extract each merged unquantized online-reference edge with endpoints and complete correction-bit fault_ids; compute h_base=round_C++(2048*w_base) and W_base=2*h_base
candidate_contract.candidate_rule_table: source-faithfully aggregate DEM marginal/joint probabilities, compute p_implied=min(0.5,joint/marginal), h_implied=round_C++(2048*log((1-p_implied)/p_implied)), and W_implied=2*h_implied
candidate_contract.candidate_execution: insert integral h_base and h_implied through the pinned audit adapter; unchanged PyMatching integer discretization doubles both to the explicit even W values, then unchanged two-pass correlated MWPM performs first match, strict-lowering reweight, and second match
unchanged: distance-6 X/Z circuits, 71 active qubits, physical noise, and 1,000-round horizon
all graph endpoints and detector/observable correction-bit output maps
decomposed correlation groups, arrival order, propagation, frame, and residual rules
exact two-pass MWPM algorithm and strict-lowering rewrite semantics
single-stream execution with no cross-shot batching
candidate_contract.changed: both merged base-edge weights and every implied replacement weight are explicitly rounded onto the same unsigned 16-bit even grid

fresh_holdout_contract.seed_derivation: little-endian uint64 from the first eight SHA-256 bytes of public_freeze_commit:discussion_number:seed_namespace:basis

semantic_veto.veto_rule: no representation or payload result is credited if any required semantic, residual, source, seed, or width condition fails

controller_payload_contract.first_pass_path: decode_to_edges_array with correlations disabled on the same explicit integer base graph
controller_payload_contract.replacement_count: unique target edges whose implied half-weight is strictly lower than the current base or already selected replacement; this reproduces PyMatching apply_reweights instead of counting every related edge
controller_payload_contract.latency_interpretation: payload bits are not cycles, bandwidth, p99 latency, LUTs, BRAMs, timing closure, or device evidence

kaggle_inspired_evaluation.verification_veto: fresh candidate frames, full-block reference frames, every residual, source binding, adapter hash, seed, corpus hash, and integer width must verify before payload is discussed
kaggle_inspired_evaluation.cost_after_verification: report the exact 16-bit even representation and actual strict-lowering replacement payload without converting it into unmeasured hardware latency
kaggle_inspired_evaluation.aggregate: X and Z must both pass; no average can hide a failed basis
kaggle_inspired_evaluation.absolute_guardrail: the existing p99 <=1 microsecond and deadline-miss <=1 percent gates remain open and cannot be waived by semantic admission

classification_rule.rule: apply source, exact per-window semantic, final-frame, and residual verification first, then 16-bit width admission; even a pass cannot cross the pinned Micro Blossom dynamic-write source gap

execution_guard.preflight_before_publication: reconstruct all 328 real graphs and rewrite tables at half-weight scale 2048, verify exact integer ranges, 16-bit fit, and adapter activation, and run only all-zero syndromes; observe zero fresh stochastic samples
